d:
From the first light of morning to the calm of evening, some melodies stay with us all day long!
Enjoy “Subah Se Lekar Shaam Tak” in stunning 8K video quality, from the hit Hindi film Mohra (1994), featuring Akshay Kumar and Raveena Tandon. Sung by the melodious Sadhana Sargam & Udit Narayan, this memorable track brings back the charm of 90s Bollywood music and its unforgettable songs.

Song: Subah Se Lekar Shaam Tak

Star Cast: Akshay Kumar & Raveena Tandon
